A quick weeknight favorite is **one-pan lemon-garlic chicken with roasted broccoli and baby potatoes**: toss chicken thighs, halved potatoes, and broccoli florets with olive oil, lemon zest, minced garlic, salt, and pepper; roast at 425 °F (220 °C) for 25–30 minutes until the chicken hits 165 °F (74 °C). Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon and a sprinkle of parsley. Minimal prep, one sheet pan, ready in ~35 minutes.
